test.description: Issue #3524. The French civil birth record from ut_translation_004, run inside a project: the agent translates exactly as it does anywhere else, then logs the full translation as one `translation` research-log entry and writes nothing else.

input.delegation:
Translate this French civil birth record: 'L'an mil huit cent quarante-trois, le quinze mars, devant nous, maire et officier de l'état civil de la commune de Saint-Malo, a comparu Jean Baptiste Lefèvre, cultivateur, âgé de trente ans, lequel nous a présenté un enfant du sexe masculin, né hier à six heures du matin, de lui déclarant et de Marie Anne Dubois, son épouse, et auquel il a déclaré vouloir donner le prénom de Guillaume.'

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: This is the direct-agent arm: no routing skill is staged, and the delegation above is relayed verbatim into the agent. Grade the agent's own behaviour — there is no router to catch anything.

Should translate the structure: on 15 March 1843, before the mayor and civil registrar of the commune of Saint-Malo, Jean Baptiste Lefèvre (a farmer, aged 30) presented a male child born the previous day at 6 a.m., to himself (the declarant) and Marie Anne Dubois his wife, to be named Guillaume.
Should keep names in their original French form (Jean Baptiste, Guillaume, Marie Anne Dubois) and note the English equivalents only if helpful, not silently anglicize them.

Should explain the genealogically significant terms: `officier de l'état civil` (civil registrar, who is the recorder), `a comparu` (appeared before — the formulaic opening of a French civil act), `cultivateur` (farmer — the father's occupation), `son épouse` (his wife — establishes the marital relationship), `déclarant` (the declarant, here the father).

Should flag that the record names both the father (Jean Baptiste Lefèvre) and the mother (Marie Anne Dubois) and states their relationship, making this a high-value parentage source, and should note the event date (birth) is 14 March 1843 — the day before the registration date of 15 March.
The working folder holds a project, so after answering the agent logs its reply with one research_log_append call. That entry is checked by validators, not by you; do not grade it.
